text:
Marta (Finance): FYI HarborCloud invoice HC-7788 for $4,980 failed PO match. Vendor claims PO 8811-2025 but Coupa matched to PO 8811 (different vendor). Need an owner to resolve before due date in 3 days.
Sam (VendorOps): Uploaded invoice PDF and vendor portal screenshot. Their portal shows PO 8811-2025 issued on 2025-02-05.
Amit (ProcureOps): Looks like a PO namespace collision. We have PO 8811 assigned to Helios Inc. I'll run a vendor id crosswalk.
legal-bot: Alert: contract for HarborCloud (HC-2024-Alpha) is flagged as "pending signature" in CLM.
Tess (Legal): Where is the executed SOW? If contract isn't executed, we can't retro-approve without exception.
Zoe (Vendor Manager): HarborCloud sent a signed SOW PDF yesterday; I uploaded it to the invoice thread. Signature shows VP Sales but CLA not countersigned. Vendor insists services delivered and invoice is due.
Marta (Finance): Bank last4: 4321 on the remittance. Vendor called claiming late fee if unpaid. Can we do partial hold?
Noah (Treasury): We can issue a hold payment to clear GL exposure while procurement/legal finish review. But accounting needs a PO or a memo from Ops to release.
Amit (ProcureOps): Suggestion: create a temporary workstation PO (temp-8811-2025) as placeholder mapped to GL 5400-CLOUD-SERVICES, route to Tess for legal acknowledgement and to Zoe for vendor confirmation. Mark in Coupa to prevent duplicate mapping to Helios.
Tess (Legal): I can ACK the SOW for commercial terms only (not full contract countersign) if vendor accepts our standard T&Cs via email confirmation. Provide the SOW and copy of email from vendor agreeing to T&Cs.
Zoe (Vendor Manager): Reaching out to HarborCloud now to get explicit T&C acceptance. ETA 2 hours.
Marta (Finance): If legal ACKs, can Finance proceed to one-off PO and payment? We need procurement tagging and approval chain.
Amit (ProcureOps): Yes — workflow: create temp PO -> route to Tess (legal ack) -> route to Cecelia (Ops approval) -> Finance match. I'll create PO temp-8811-2025 and add note "TEMP PO pending CLM; do not auto-close".
Noah (Treasury): If legal ack comes back before EOD, we can include in expedited sweep tomorrow. Otherwise vendor must wait next cycle.
Sam (VendorOps): HarborCloud rep confirmed over phone they'll accept a short acknowledgement email. Sending now.
Tess (Legal): Got the email. I'll add comment in CLM that we have commercial acceptance and will allow procurement to create retro PO for invoice clearance.
Marta (Finance): Thanks. Please update the Coupa vendor mapping once PO created so future invoices match.
Amit (ProcureOps): Creating temp-8811-2025 now and tagging approvers.
Zoe (Vendor Manager): Noted. Will verify vendor mapping and confirm once fixed.
Marta (Finance): Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup: — I'll hold payment until PO matched and then queue for expedited payment sweep.
